title: Type of construction.
officialText:
Airport traffic control towers shall be constructed to comply with the height and area limitations of Table
412.3.2.
TABLE 412.3.2
HEIGHT AND AREA LIMITATIONS FOR AIRPORT
TRAFFIC CONTROL TOWERS
TYPE OF HEIGHTa MAXIMUM
CONSTRUCTION (feet) AREA
(square feet)
IA Unlimited 1,500
IB 240 1,500
IIA 100 1,500
IIB 85 1,500
IIIA 65 1,500
For SI: 1 foot = 304.8 mm, 1 square foot = 0.0929 m2.
a. Height to be measured from grade plane to cab floor.
